crossRefs.note: I think it right, as long as I am in this tent, to stir you up by reminding you,
For most certainly in this we groan, longing to be clothed with our habitation which is from heaven,
if indeed being clothed, we will not be found naked.
He has swallowed up death forever! The Lord Yahweh will wipe away tears from off all faces. He will take the reproach…
For this perishable body must become imperishable, and this mortal must put on immortality.
But when this perishable body will have become imperishable, and this mortal will have put on immortality, then what is…

translations.web: For indeed we who are in this tent do groan, being burdened, not that we desire to be unclothed, but that we desire to be clothed, that what is mortal may be swallowed up by life.
translations.bsb: For while we are in this tent, we groan under our burdens, because we do not wish to be unclothed but clothed, so that our mortality may be swallowed up by life.
translations.kjv: For we that are in this tabernacle do groan, being burdened: not for that we would be unclothed, but clothed upon, that mortality might be swallowed up of life.
translations.asv: For indeed we that are in this tabernacle do groan, being burdened; not for that we would be unclothed, but that we would be clothed upon, that what is mortal may be swallowed up of life.
